decisions.decision: Player list indicator is injected by Voice.paint() into .sec-players .pl rows (index maps to S.players) instead of editing playersListHTML
decisions.why: common.js is hash-pinned and must not change

decisions.decision: Mod3D desk speaking marker is a data-spk attribute on the desk label (.tag) with a CSS ::before, not a three.js sprite
decisions.why: the label is re-created via className/textContent on state change; an attribute survives that, and it follows the desk per frame already

decisions.decision: Incoming v:sig ice is matched to inbound or outbound connection by usernameFragment vs the remote SDP ufrag
decisions.why: relay payload has no direction and a pid can be both my speaker and my listener

decisions.decision: Game-muted (gm) main button is disabled; self-mute button stays available while voice is on

summary: Voice client done on fe/voice-over (7bab1d1): syntax-checked and stub-tested only, no live browser/WebRTC test; common.js untouched.
